title: Stepwise covariate selection for a parametric hazard model — hzr_stepwise
text: steps data frame columns: step_num Integer sequence starting 1. action "enter", "drop", "frozen". variable Variable affected. phase Phase name (multiphase) NA_character_. criterion "wald" "aic". score Winning score used decision. stat, df Wald statistic degrees freedom. p_value, delta_aic Always populated computable, regardless active criterion. logLik, aic, n_coef Goodness--fit diagnostics model step.

title: Stepwise covariate selection for a parametric hazard model — hzr_stepwise
text: Two arguments shape search.  direction decides moves allowed step; criterion decides candidate move scored whether accepted. direction = "forward" Start base model add variables — best eligible candidate enters step none clears entry rule.  Variables never leave . direction = "backward" Start full candidate model drop variables — weakest term leaves step survivors clear retention rule. direction = "" (default) Two-way stepwise: entry, already-selected variables re-tested may dropped. SAS SELECTION = STEPWISE strategy.  max_move caps often single variable may oscillate frozen. criterion = "wald" (default) Accept moves SAS-style significance thresholds, using Wald \(\chi^2\) affected coefficient(s): candidate enters p-value slentry, term dropped p-value rises slstay.  Entry candidates scored refit adds candidate (new coefficient can tested); drop candidates scored current model's Wald p-values without per-candidate refit, single refit run drop chosen.  Note differs algorithmically C/SAS HAZARD, selects score (Q) statistic evaluated without refitting; two can take different step paths even converge similar final model. criterion = "aic" Accept move \(\Delta\mathrm{AIC} < 0\) (strictly better penalised fit), ignoring slentry / slstay.  Entry candidates use actual \(\Delta\mathrm{AIC}\) candidate refit; drop candidates use Wald--likelihood-ratio approximation, \(\Delta\mathrm{AIC} \approx W - 2\,\mathrm{df}\), computed current model without per-candidate refit (chosen drop refit afterwards).  Use non-significance-based, information-criterion search.

text: Conservation--Events fits now report full-information variance. Conservation Events ignored left-truncation (counting-process entry times). multiphase fits Surv(start, stop, event) data, CoE reparameterization conserved Sum H(stop) likelihood scores intercepts entry-time scale, Sum E = Sum [H(stop) - H(start)]. conserved phase therefore absorbed spurious Sum H(start), biasing intercept lowering attained log-likelihood (hz.te123.OMC fit-1 parity offset, gap-list P1 #6). .hzr_conserve_events() .hzr_select_fixmu_phase() now subtract per-phase entry-time cumulative hazard, matching likelihood C HAZARD setcoe LCENSOR/ STARTTME. Plain right-censored fits (start time) unaffected. vcov() unusable multiphase fits returned unnamed matrix. vcov.hazard() collapsed entire matrix scalar NA whenever cell NA. Multiphase fits legitimately NA variance rows – parameters held fixed (e.g. early shapes) Conservation--Events-conserved phase log_mu – finite free-parameter block discarded almost every multiphase model. method now returns full matrix NA rows preserved labels rows columns coefficient names (phase-prefixed multiphase, e.g. early.x vs constant.x), covariate shared across phases resolves distinct, name-addressable slots. scalar NA returned covariance matrix available. Weibull analytic gradient produced NaN right-censored time = 0 rows. .hzr_gradient_weibull() used unguarded log(time) shape (nu) score; legal right-censored row time = 0 made 0 * -Inf = NaN, poisoned entire summed shape-gradient component (silently zeroed optimizer, harming convergence). log(time) now guarded log(pmax(time, .Machine$double.xmin)), matching analytic Hessian. families audited: exponential (log(time) score), log-normal (rejects time = 0), multiphase (decomposition clamps time) unaffected. Weibull event hazard inconsistent cumulative hazard. .hzr_logl_weibull() defined event hazard mu*nu*t^(nu-1)*exp(eta) cumulative hazard (mu*t)^nu*exp(eta); former missing mu^(nu-1) factor (exact derivative nu*mu^nu*t^(nu-1)*exp(eta) = (nu/t)*H, Form C/SAS HAZARD reference). natural-scale log-likelihood analytic gradient (d/dmu, d/dnu event terms) corrected match. Pure event/right-censored fits already correct (use self-consistent internal reparameterization); visible effect mixed event + interval/left-censored Weibull fits, delegate likelihood previously optimized slightly mis-specified event term. Weibull gradient attribute ignored observation weights. .hzr_logl_weibull(..., return_gradient = TRUE) attached unweighted gradient even weights supplied (analytic gradient weight scale, e.g. halved weights = 2). weights now forwarded score computation. model-fitting path unaffected (uses separate internal weighted gradient); changes callers reading return_gradient = TRUE attribute weighted data. hzr_bootstrap() non-functional weighted fits (Phase 7c). resample loop rewired data refit call, leaving original weights argument bound symbol caller’s frame. internal eval() resolve symbol, every replicate weighted model errored (n_success == 0) regardless fraction; even resolved, un-resampled weights misaligned bootstrapped rows. weights now evaluated resampled lockstep data replicate (mirroring data handled). Unweighted bootstraps unaffected. regression test covers fraction < 1 full-size weighted paths test-diagnostics.R. Caller-frame evaluation remains fallback objects fitted weights stored. fragility applied call’s data argument: hazard() now stores evaluated data argument (data frame passed hazard(), model.frame() result) fitted object (object$data$frame), hzr_bootstrap() resamples stored frame instead re-evaluating cl$data parent.frame(), bootstrap succeeds even original data symbol scope. Caller-frame evaluation remains fallback objects fitted frame stored. 4-phase CoE fixmu-phase selection (Phase 7d). .hzr_select_fixmu_phase() used .max() raw per-phase cumhaz starting theta. G3 late phases typical shape parameters unnormalized cumhaz orders magnitude larger phases, causing CoE pin G3 log_mu away true near-zero MLE. Fixed excluding phases whose cumhaz contribution exceeds 10× median selecting (falls back .max phases outliers). 4-phase CABGKUL fit CoE vs -CoE LL gap closes 6.9 < 0.1 units. Six new tests cover 4-phase code path test-conservation--events.R. time_lower dual-use bug Weibull multiphase likelihoods. time_lower supplied mixed interval-censored + right-censored dataset, Weibull LL interpreted time_lower counting-process entry time right-censored rows, computing H(stop) − H(start) = 0 silently zeroing rows’ likelihood contribution. Fixed likelihood-weibull.R (4 sites: LL, gradient, L-BFGS-B internal LL/gradient) likelihood-multiphase.R: start_vec now set time_lower genuine epoch rows (status %% c(0L, 1L) time_lower < time). Two regression tests added test-interval-censoring-weibull.R. hzr_decompos() Case 3 corrected nu = 0, m >= 0 now fails loud (Phase 7d). Two issues early-phase (G1) sign dispatch: Case 3 (m > 0, nu < 0, “bounded cumulative”) carried spurious factor m. rho used bare (2^m - 1)^nu instead ((2^m - 1)/m)^nu form used Case 1, leaving m factor bt^(-1/nu) term. title: TemporalHazard 1.1.0
text: Hardened Hessian inversion standard errors (Phase 7c). Post-fit variance-covariance estimation now symmetrizes Hessian, checks reciprocal condition number, inverts via Cholesky solve() fallback non-positive-definite Hessians, guards non-positive variances instead silently emitting NaN standard errors. Ill-conditioned, non-positive-definite, non-finite Hessians now raise specific, named warnings, fits carry rcond / pd diagnostics summary() surfaces note fit flagged. closes “12+-parameter Hessian stability” hardening item inversion layer; analytic Hessians (accurate standard errors) follow subsequent releases. Analytic Hessian exponential standard errors (Phase 7c, Layer 2). exponential distribution now computes post-fit Hessian closed form (X~' diag(wH) X~ event + right-censored rows) rather numerically, giving accurate standard errors. shared optimizer gained hessian_fn hook analytic Hessians remaining families reuse; left/interval-censored exponential fits fall back numerical Hessian. Analytic Hessian Weibull standard errors (Phase 7c, Layer 2). Weibull distribution now computes post-fit Hessian closed form internal (alpha, psi, beta) optimization scale (mapped natural scale existing delta method) rather numerically, giving accurate standard errors. Covers event + right-censored data (including counting-process start times); left/interval-censored fits fall back numerical Hessian. Analytic Hessian log-logistic standard errors (Phase 7c, Layer 2). log-logistic distribution now computes post-fit Hessian closed form internal (log alpha, log beta, beta_coef) scale rather numerically, giving accurate standard errors. Covers event + right-censored data; left/interval-censored fits fall back numerical Hessian. Analytic Hessian log-normal standard errors (Phase 7c, Layer 2). log-normal distribution now computes post-fit Hessian closed form internal (mu, log_sigma, beta_coef) scale rather numerically, giving accurate standard errors. Covers event + right-censored data; left/interval-censored fits fall back numerical Hessian. Analytic Hessian multiphase standard errors (Phase 7c, Layer 2 PR-6). Post-fit standard errors multiphase fits now come closed-form Hessian negative log-likelihood rather numerical Richardson approximation. Hessian assembled three terms: () phase-block-diagonal curvature Σᵢ wᵢ H(tᵢ), (B) dense Fisher information outer product Σₑ (wᵢ/hᵢ²) ∇h ∇hᵀ capturing cross-phase parameter interactions, (C) phase-block-diagonal curvature −Σₑ wᵢ log h(tᵢ). μ/β parameters use fully closed-form expressions; shape parameters (t_half, ν, m, G3 parameters) use second-order central differences. Conservation--Events full-information vcov path also switches analytic Hessian. Left/interval-censored fits fall back numerical Hessian. Completes 6-PR analytic-Hessian rollout across five families.

title: TemporalHazard 0.9.8

title: TemporalHazard 0.9.7

title: TemporalHazard 0.9.3
text: hzr_deciles() — Decile--risk calibration function comparing observed vs. expected event counts across risk groups chi-square GOF testing. Implements SAS deciles.hazard.sas macro workflow. hzr_gof() — Goodness--fit function comparing parametric predictions nonparametric (Kaplan-Meier) estimates observed vs. expected event counting. Implements SAS hazplot.sas macro workflow. hzr_kaplan() — Kaplan-Meier survival estimator logit-transformed confidence limits respect [0, 1] boundary, interval hazard rate, density, restricted mean survival time (life integral). Implements SAS kaplan.sas macro output structure. hzr_calibrate() — Variable calibration function assessing functional form model entry. Groups continuous covariate quantile bins applies logit, Gompertz, Cox link transforms. Supports stratification via parameter. Implements SAS logit.sas logitgr.sas macros. hzr_nelson() — Wayne Nelson cumulative hazard estimator lognormal confidence limits. Supports weighted events severity-adjusted repeated event analyses. Implements SAS nelsonl.sas macro. hzr_bootstrap() — Bootstrap resampling hazard model coefficients bagging support (fractional sampling). Returns per-replicate estimates summary statistics (mean, SD, percentile CI). Implements SAS bootstrap.hazard.sas macro workflow. hzr_competing_risks() — Competing risks cumulative incidence using Aalen-Johansen estimator Greenwood variance. Handles number competing event types. Implements SAS markov.sas macro. Conservation Events (CoE) — Turner’s theorem now integrated multiphase optimizer. One phase’s log_mu scaling parameter solved analytically iteration, reducing optimization dimension 1 improving numerical stability convergence. Enabled default; disable control = list(conserve = FALSE). Implements core algorithm C HAZARD setcoe.c / consrv.c.
